title: sca-v20 Multi-Dim SOTA-Repo Verdict
description: Multi-dim scoring extension of sca-v18. 19 dimensions across 8 clusters with per-decision-class weighting (INSTALL/PATTERN-STUDY/CITE-ONLY/MONITOR). Stars stay informational-only (OSSF Criticality formula excludes stars). Pareto-frontier preserved via per-class scoring (no single scalar). Cite-anchored to W376 SYNTHESIS S9-S12 + sca-v18 lineage + OSSF Criticality + DSPy GEPA Pareto-frontier (arxiv 2507.19457) + Kapravelos ICSE-26 fake-stars + MALTA (arxiv 2603.10265) + verdict-jury L3 + CLAUDE.md cardinal-rule-1 trust-tuple + cardinal-rule-6 verify-before-claim. Authored 2026-05-23 from W377 META-C stream.

schema_version.description: Schema lineage marker. Strict superset of sca-v18.

stream_id.description: W377 stream id e.g. META-C, META-A

dimensions.description: 19 dimensions across 8 clusters per META-C §1. Required = the minimum subset for tier routing. Stars cluster (D01-D03) is optional + informational-only.

D01_stars_raw.description: Cluster I — Popularity. Informational ONLY. NEVER weighted into INSTALL/PATTERN-STUDY/CITE-ONLY scores. Source: gh-api /repos/{owner}/{name}.stargazers_count. Anti-game: MALTA fake-star check.

D02_stars_growth_per_month.description: Cluster I — Popularity. stars/month last 90d. Informational. Source: github star-history. Anti-game: cross-check vs commit cadence.

D03_forks_per_star.description: Cluster I — Popularity. forks_count / stargazers_count. Informational. Healthy 0.05-0.15; <0.01 vanity; >0.5 template.

D04_last_commit_days.description: Cluster II — Activity. Days since HEAD commit. INSTALL pass ≤90, PATTERN-STUDY ≤365, CITE-ONLY ≤730, BLOCK if >730d AND archived=true. Source: gh-api .pushed_at + git log -1 --format=%cI.

D05_contributors_90d.description: Cluster II — Activity. Contributor count last 90d, bot-stripped. INSTALL pass ≥5, PATTERN-STUDY ≥2. Source: gh-api /contributors paginate + commit-author-date filter.

D06_issue_close_rate_90d.description: Cluster II — Activity. closed_issues_90d / opened_issues_90d. INSTALL pass ≥0.4, PATTERN-STUDY ≥0.2. Source: gh-api. Anti-game: exclude pure stale-bot closes.

D07_license_class.description: Cluster III — Trust. Inherits sca-v18 license_class enum. INSTALL hard-filter: must be permissive (or operator-attestation on source-available). BLOCK on proprietary OR noassertion. Source: gh-api /license + LICENSE file read (cross-verify).

D08_signed_release_level.description: Cluster III — Trust. SLSA-L0..L4. INSTALL pass ≥2 OR operator-attestation. Source: slsa-verifier CLI + npm-provenance + signed git-tags. Anti-game: claimed-not-verified worse than not-claimed (BLOCK).

D09_maintainer_reputation_tier.description: Cluster III — Trust. Inherits sca-v18 maintainership_tier enum. INSTALL pass ∈ {A,B}, PATTERN-STUDY ∈ {A,B,C}, CITE-ONLY ∈ {A,B,C,D}. F=stale/abandoned. Source: corporate-backing + named-prod-users + commit cadence.

D10_test_coverage_pct.description: Cluster IV — Quality. INSTALL pass ≥0.6, PATTERN-STUDY ≥0.4. Source: codecov/coveralls badge + pytest --cov reproducible. Anti-game: check tests-LOC / src-LOC ratio (healthy 0.3-0.8).

D11_ci_green_streak_days.description: Cluster IV — Quality. Consecutive-success days on default branch, required-status-checks only. INSTALL pass ≥14, PATTERN-STUDY ≥3. Source: gh-api /actions/runs. Anti-game: filter to required checks (lint workflows inflate).

D12_doc_completeness_score.description: Cluster IV — Quality. README depth + per-module docs + deepwiki + recipe count. INSTALL pass ≥0.5, PATTERN-STUDY ≥0.7, CITE-ONLY ≥0.8. Source: deepwiki + manual rubric. Anti-game: auto-gen boilerplate scores 0.3-0.5; hand-curated 0.8-1.0.

D13_cc_install_path.description: Cluster V — Claude Code runtime fit (NEW v20). INSTALL hard-filter: ∈ {plugin, mcp-server, sdk-python, sdk-typescript}. cli-only and library-only route to PATTERN-STUDY. none = full skip. Source: .claude/plugin.json OR mcp.json OR package.json:claude-code-skill OR PyPI/npm pkg + entrypoint.

D14_cc_pattern_density.description: Cluster V — Claude Code runtime fit. unique_patterns_in_repo / 12 known-pattern-slots (orchestrator-workers, evaluator-optimizer, parallel-fanout, callbacks-stream, asyncio-shield-cleanup, container-isolation, retry-policy, structured-output, MCP-tool-bridging, hierarchical-delegation, memory-tiering, jury-with-veto). PATTERN-STUDY pass ≥0.4, CITE-ONLY ≥0.2. Source: deepwiki + repomix. Anti-game: each pattern MUST cite file:line.

D15_cc_cite_anchor_density.description: Cluster V — Claude Code runtime fit. files_with_stable_paths / total_files * file_stability_90d_factor. PATTERN-STUDY pass ≥0.3, CITE-ONLY ≥0.5. Source: codegraph + repomix + git log --diff-filter=R. Anti-game: rename-heavy repos cannot anchor.

D16_cc_deepwiki_indexed.description: Cluster V — Claude Code runtime fit. CITE-ONLY required true. Source: deepwiki.com/{owner}/{name} HTTP 200 + ask_question non-empty.

D17_pinning_discipline.description: Cluster VI — Production-readiness. INSTALL pass ∈ {image-digest-sha256, git-commit-sha, npm-exact-version, uvx-exact-version}. Inherits sca-v18 cr9_pinning_strategy enum. Source: inspect own pinning of upstream + ability to pin THIS repo.

D18_arch_relevance_score.description: Cluster VII — Architectural relevance. Composite over: matches-our-6-tier-memory (T1..T6), matches-our-4-mode-parallel, Temporal/asyncio compat, Pydantic-v2 native, MCP-native, Anthropic-cite-anchorable. INSTALL pass ≥0.5, CITE-ONLY ≥0.4. Source: cite each sub-axis to CLAUDE.md cardinal-rule or docs anchor.

D19_community_external_mentions.description: Cluster VIII — Community signal. cited-by other top-50 repos + arxiv refs + HN/Reddit story-count last 90d. PATTERN-STUDY pass ≥3, CITE-ONLY ≥3 (sca-v13 3-org-distinct floor). Source: gh code search + perplexity + exa. Anti-game: N LLM-judges parroting same blog = 1 mention.

per_class_scores.description: Per-decision-class weighted scores per META-C §2. NOT a single scalar — each class has its own weight profile. Pareto-frontier preserved.

install.description: Weighted sum per §2 INSTALL weight profile. Stars cluster weight=0. License weight=0.15 (hard filter). Signed-release weight=0.10.

pattern_study.description: Weighted sum per §2 PATTERN-STUDY weight profile. cc_pattern_density weight=0.25 (highest). doc_completeness 0.15. cc_cite_anchor_density 0.15.

cite_only.description: Weighted sum per §2 CITE-ONLY weight profile. cc_cite_anchor_density weight=0.30 (highest). doc_completeness 0.20. cc_deepwiki_indexed 0.20.

monitor.description: Weighted sum per §2 MONITOR profile. Stars cluster non-zero here (drift detection). community_mentions weight=0.10.

tier.description: Inherits sca-v18 5-tier soft-gate ladder. Routed per META-C §3 logic: hard BLOCK filters first, then try INSTALL → PATTERN-STUDY → CITE-ONLY → MONITOR. Soft-routing-down only; never silently up.

hard_filter_violations.description: Per-class hard-filter violations that downgrade from INSTALL → lower tier. Transparency record.

reason.description: Free-text explanation, e.g. 'cli-only path is not Claude-Code-installable primitive'

value.description: The measured value (number, string, or bool)

source_uri_or_ref.description: URL, file:line, gh-api endpoint, or operator-sign reference

dimension_anchors.description: Per-dim provenance for cite-anchor discipline (cardinal-rule-6 verify-before-claim). Each dim key (e.g. D04_last_commit_days) maps to its anchor object.

decision_class_rationale.description: Per-class free-text rationale for the score. NOT just the scalar — explain what drove the weighting outcome and any hard-filter triggers.

install.description: Why INSTALL score = X. Cite specific hard-filter passes/fails.

monitor.description: Optional — explain MONITOR drift signals if relevant

confidence.description: TOP-LEVEL confidence = MIN over confidence_by_dimension axes (sca-v18 codex r2 G2 carry-forward). HIGH requires: ≥2 CLASS-A sources per required dim + no disagreements + jury_verdict APPROVE.

confidence_by_dimension.description: Per-dim confidence breakdown (Pareto-frontier-aware). Each dim key maps to its confidence level.

rationale.description: Top-level free-text rationale for tier routing + per-class scores. References specific dim values + cite anchors.

stars_informational.description: Inherits sca-v18 stars_informational block. NEVER weighted into INSTALL/PATTERN-STUDY/CITE-ONLY scores. Stars only contribute to MONITOR class (drift detection).

convergence.description: Inherits sca-v18 convergence model. Multi-MCP class-weighted-counting (CLASS-A raw / CLASS-B LLM-judges / CLASS-C AI-on-repo+academic). INSTALL minimum: ≥1 CLASS-A AND ≥1 CLASS-C.

jury_verdict.description: Inherits sca-v18 jury_verdict block. K=4 weighted-by-per-instance-reliability jury (arxiv 2512.01786). Minority-veto n≥2 BLOCK override (arxiv 2510.11822). K=2 minimum for INSTALL tier.

cardinal_rule_compliance.description: Inherits sca-v18 cardinal-rule compliance block. CLAUDE.md CR-1 trust-tuple + CR-6 verify-before-claim + CR-9 pinning.

dimensions_anchor_count_meets_3_org_dist.description: Per sca-v13 — at least 3 distinct orgs in dimension_anchors source_uri_or_ref

weights_profile_version.description: Version of the §2 weight table used to compute per_class_scores. Enables R-CALIBRATION re-scoring without losing prior verdicts.

follow_up_streams.description: Inherits sca-v18 follow_up_streams. Queued: R-CALIBRATION (empirical weight tuning on 50-repo backtest), R-IMPL (tools/sca-v20-evaluate.mjs CLI), R-DASHBOARD (Pareto-frontier viz), R-CODEX (codex jury on framework), R-MIGRATION (backfill 15 repos).

extensions.description: Forward-compat reservation for v21+ additions. Use x_* prefix for custom fields.
